decisions.reason: Premium customer support sits at the core of the firm's agency-focused service model and, in a growing market with hiring and organizational slack, likely meets or exceeds aspiration levels.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting and operations capabilities, so management is likely to see it as a satisfactory strategic complement worth retaining.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively distant from the firm's core hosting business, and if its payoff is below aspiration management would likely reallocate resources to closer, more proven services and tools.

Scalable hosting for agencies is tightly aligned with the firm's main customer group and core offer, making it the kind of product a medium-sized German hosting firm would be very unlikely to withdraw while the industry is expanding.
